newsitem.title: FRANCE: Union Miniere unit raises zinc price.
newsitem.headline: Union Miniere unit raises zinc price.

text.p: Union Miniere SA subsidiary Union Miniere France on Thursday raised its indicative zinc price to 6,700 francs a tonne, the company said.
The previous posting was 6,250 francs on November 27.
The company said in a statement the rise was in line with market developments.

Shares in the Belgian non-ferrous metals producer were up four percent on Thursday on the back of rising zinc prices and investor enthusiasm for a stock that had lagged recent rises on the Brussels bourse.
